{{Short description|Dutch physicist and academic (1924–2026)}}
'''Nicolaas Marinus Hugenholtz''' (26 April 1924 – 18 February 2026) was a Dutch physicist and academic. He was a professor of theoretical physics at the [[University of Groningen]] from 1960 to 1989.<ref name=rug/>

==Life and career==
Hugenholtz was born in [[Wormerveer]] on 26 April 1924.<ref name=rug>{{cite web|author= |url=https://hoogleraren.ub.rug.nl/hoogleraren/1039-hugenholtz-nicolaas-marinus |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200511182312/https://hoogleraren.ub.rug.nl/hoogleraren/1039-hugenholtz-nicolaas-marinus |title=Nicolaas Marinus Hugenholtz (1924) |language=Dutch |publisher=University of Groningen |date= |archive-date=11 May 2020}}</ref><ref name="jaarboek">{{cite book |title=Jaarboek der Universiteit van Amsterdam |date=1961 |publisher=Universiteit van Amsterdam |page=46 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=cJSjAAAAMAAJ&q=Nicolaas+Marinus+Hugenholtz+1924 |access-date=10 March 2021 |language=Dutch}}</ref> He studied physics at [[Leiden University]] and obtained his degree in 1948. Hugenholtz subsequently studied theoretical physics under [[Hans Kramers]].<ref name="jaarboek"/> He obtained his PhD in physics at [[Utrecht University]] in 1957 with a thesis titled: ''The quantum theory of large systems and its application to the structure of nuclear matter''.<ref name=rug/>

He was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1988.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4286 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190413123733/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/4286 |title=Nico Hugenholtz |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=13 April 2019}}</ref>

Hugenholtz died on 18 February 2026, at the age of 101.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://images.nrc.nl/hfRt8QzIc5MVWnP7RrwYLKU-R-o=/filters:no_upscale():format(jpeg):fill(f8f8f8,true)/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20260221/528-advertisement-297287_1349405_hugenholtz01ra-526780-eeaaa2.png |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260223194717/https://images.nrc.nl/hfRt8QzIc5MVWnP7RrwYLKU-R-o=/filters:no_upscale():format(jpeg):fill(f8f8f8,true)/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20260221/528-advertisement-297287_1349405_hugenholtz01ra-526780-eeaaa2.png |title=Nico Hugenholtz |language=nl |publisher=NRC Handelsblad |date=21 February 2026 |archive-date=23 February 2026}}</ref>
